title: lint: state-machine-no-initial-states passes an initialStates list that names every option, which refuses nothing on insert (split from #35251)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUZrkMKgGrXXe8zPGq

Filing gate: **(c) a residual a card's review names** — carries the every-option residual of #35251 (scope note 6992730706, from the contract-review delta 6992699203 on PR #35244). #35251 keeps the update-only predicate, the three showcase lists and the negative pin (claim 7016093607); this card carries only the residual below. Split on the seat's order. ⛔ Not a claim; grade left to triage's first touch.

## What happens

`state-machine-no-initial-states` (publish-time rule from PR #35244, `packages/lint/src/validate-inert-object-declarations.ts`) refuses a `state_machine` validation that runs on insert and declares no `initialStates`. An `initialStates` list that names **every** option of the state field satisfies the rule, yet it refuses nothing on insert: the declaration has no effect, the same class of inert metadata the rule exists to catch.

Seen on `crm_opportunity` (app-crm): its `initialStates` lists every option of its state field. That is honest for that app — it records deals already won or lost, and its hook and tests create them — so the example may well keep it.

## Why this needs a route before dispatch

Changing the rule here changes its **visible verdict** on a list it passes today (`crm_opportunity` lists every option). Before any dev starts, the route has to be settled — by the seat, or by the maintainer's ruling if it is a product choice:

- (A) the rule keeps passing an every-option list (no change; document why);
- (B) an every-option list draws a warning, not a refusal;
- (C) an every-option list is refused like a missing one.

And whether app-crm's `crm_opportunity` keeps its list.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "STATE_MACHINE_NO_INITIAL_STATES" origin/main -- packages/lint/src` · the `initialStates` of `crm_opportunity` under `examples/app-crm/`.

Dedupe: issue search `initialStates every option`, `state-machine-no-initial-states inert` → only #35251 and #34776.
